title: PriorityChef Premium Stainless Steel Colander for Kitchen, Durable Rice and Pasta Strainer with Handle, Rust-Resistant & Dishwasher Safe, 3 Qt
description:
About this item
Fast Draining Micro-Perforations – This stainless steel kitchen strainer ensures quick and efficient straining for even the smallest grains. No more lost rice or pasta!
Versatile Rice Strainer & Noodle Strainer – Designed for all your needs, this food strainer is perfect for draining rice, pasta, vegetables, and more without any ingredients slipping through.
Raised Base for Cleaner Counters – Unlike flat colanders & food strainers, our metal colander for kitchen features an elevated base, keeping water away from your food and counters dry.
Strong & Durable Stainless Steel – This heavy-duty metal strainer with handle won’t bend or rust. A reliable strainers for kitchen essential that’s built to last through years of cooking.
Large, Easy to Hold Handles & Dishwasher Safe – Large, sturdy handles on our pasta drainer provide a secure grip, making the process effortless. This food strainer and colander set is completely dishwasher safe for a quick and hassle-free cleanup.
